"Challenges hi life ko interesting banate."
Time limited hai—dusre ki life jeeke waste mat karo.
Earth par sabse strong force—human mind.
"Tum kya karte ho itna loud bolta—kehna sunai nahi deta."
Risk nahi loge toh ordinary hi reh jaoge.
Failure feedback hai, defeat nahi.
"Chaaho tum, ya socho nahi—right tum hi ho."
Magic nahi—sab mindset aur effort hai.
Jo shot nahi lete, unka 100% chance chook jate ho.
Mind powerful servant hai, terrible master mat bano.
Jo duniya badalne ki himmat rakhte hain, wahi badalte hain.
